name: k9-kit
about: A mod's own enemy kind built on LumaKit (plan 5.2; lumakit.md 2.4, 2.6; abi draft 3 addition 2): every Goomba is made as Chaser, which walks toward the player through kit.actor; the player, placed above the first one, lands on it; the Chaser is told of the trample through kit.actor.attack_of and, defeated, drops two coins through kit.actor.drop and kit.item. Every call crosses from k9-kit into lumakit through a kind 6 import
